items.headline: Chris Smalling confirmed as Porto signing
items.summary: Ex-Manchester United centre-back Chris Smalling, 36, has completed a free transfer to Porto.

items.headline: Isaac Konde joins United from Liverpool academy
items.summary: Manchester United sign 16-year-old winger Isaac Konde from Liverpool for the U18s on a five-year agreement.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes trains fully with Portugal after injury scare
items.summary: Bruno Fernandes trained fully with Portugal before Denmark after missing Wales match with a 'complicated' issue.

items.headline: Mazraoui injury concern from Morocco duties
items.summary: Noussair Mazraoui went off during Morocco's 2-0 win over Lesotho, forcing Manchester United to monitor his condition.

items.headline: Manchester United monitoring David Raum for January transfer
items.summary: RB Leipzig captain David Raum is likely target for January with contract situation making move feasible.

items.headline: Arsenal, Chelsea monitoring Brighton striker Kostoulas
items.summary: Manchester United among clubs monitoring Brighton's Charalampos Kostoulas after his strong start to 2026/27.
